sources.title: GitHub - STEERIX-home/robo-jev
sources.snippet: A small, fast decision model for robots — specialized in physical judgment. robo-jev reads a short text of what a robot senses, answers the questions that matter in the moment — will the glass tip if I brake now? does the person reach my path first? did the part seat? — and returns a calibrated probability for every answer in one forward pass of a 2B model. sources.title: GitHub - STEERIX-home/robo-jev
sources.snippet: robojev is a research project by Steerix Robotics: a learned judgment model that decides, many times per second, what a robot should do next — which action to commit to, whether to stop, whether to grip, which path and speed — from a structured description of the world, without generating text.

sources.title: robojev — A benchmark for real-time physical judgment
sources.snippet: Same robots, same situations, same controllers. Only the decision model changes. Pick a model and watch it decide, live in your browser. robojev bench is the benchmark; Jev, d1, Decision-1, GPT-6 Luna, Solar Flash and robo-jev are models you can run in it.
